name: Seated Leg Curl
summary: A machine curl performed seated, which keeps the hips stable and loads the hamstrings with the hips flexed.
setup: Adjust the seat and back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot.
Place the ankle pad just above your heels and lower the thigh pad securely across your thighs.
Sit upright with your back supported and hold the handles.
execution: Curl your heels down and back by bending your knees as far as you can control.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the bottom of the rep.
Return slowly over two to three seconds until your legs are almost straight.
Keep your back against the pad and your thighs pressed down.
mistakes: Lifting the hips or leaning back to cheat: keep the thigh pad snug and your back on the pad.
Letting the weight stack drop on the return: control the weight up slowly.
Cutting the range short: use the full range you can control.
Using a weight that is too heavy: reduce the load until you can control both directions.
